summary: Iteration_2 regression testing of the Higgsfield Pro media/asset swap-out. Backend: 41/41 pytest tests passed (all new assets 200, hero.mp4=1.78MB<8MB, dachwohnung.mp4=680KB<3MB, hero.webm & dachwohnung.webm served correctly, all old hero paths /media/hero.png,/media/hero-2400.*,/media/hero-800.webp,/media/hero-1600.webp no longer served as images, listings GET returns 7 with Dachwohnung image_url=/media/dachwohnung-800.webp + video_url=/media/dachwohnung.mp4, Lagerraum image_url=/media/lagerraum-800.webp, Landhaus image_url=/media/landhaus-800.webp, valuation LLM produces German commentary with min<=expected<=max and no '15 Jahre' claim, inquiries persist, admin login rejects wrong / accepts correct password, admin-only endpoints require X-Admin-Password, chat SSE streams German deltas ending in done). Frontend: all 8 sections render, no runtime error overlay; Hero has AVIF + WebP covering 800/1600 (fixed vs iteration_1 where AVIF only had 2400), img[fetchpriority=high][decoding=async] present, desktop renders

minor.issue: Body validation still runs before admin-password check (returns 422 without header instead of 401). Carried over from iteration_1, not a security issue.

issues: When user clicks val-next twice without changing default inputs and submits, the valuation LLM can return a negative expected value (observed: CHF -9'656). Defaults should either be pre-populated with sensible non-zero values or the wizard should require key fields (area, rooms) before val-submit is enabled. Cosmetic only when user provides real inputs — test_valuation with realistic payload returns a valid positive CHF figure.

action_items: (Optional) Prevent the Bewertung wizard from allowing val-submit with empty/zero area & rooms — either disable the button or set sensible defaults so the LLM cannot produce negative valuations.
(Optional, carried) Reorder POST /api/listings to check X-Admin-Password header before Pydantic validation so unauthorised writes return 401 instead of 422.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero component correctly gates <video> behind desktop viewport + prefers-reduced-motion=no-preference — good perf/UX practice.
AVIF <source> is now complete for 800/1600 widths (regression from iteration_1's design_issue).
Listing.video_url field is populated only for Dachwohnung; hover video component correctly renders <video> only when the field is set.
Old media files (hero.png, hero-2400.*, hero-{800,1600}.webp) are physically removed from /app/frontend/public/media/; SPA catch-all now returns text/html for those paths which is acceptable.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated media asset list to new Higgsfield Pro set; added hero.mp4/webm size+ctype checks, dachwohnung.mp4/webm checks, lagerraum image_url + dachwohnung.video_url assertions)
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ inquiry via /api/inquiries, one TEST_Playwright2 inquiry via Kontakt UI. Non-destructive.
perf_note: Lighthouse not run in this env. LCP-candidate hero-poster-800.avif is 43'284 bytes (~43 KB) — well within budget; hero.webm=1'274'176 bytes (1.22 MB), hero.mp4=1'778'478 bytes (1.7 MB). With on a 43 KB AVIF and video gated to desktop+no-reduced-motion, mobile LCP should comfortably be < 2.5 s over 4G.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers the new Higgsfield Pro asset set (hero-poster-*, dachwohnung.mp4/webm, hero.mp4/webm, invest, relocation, erbe, lagerraum). Video-size limits enforced: hero.mp4 <= 8MB, dachwohnung.mp4 <= 3MB. Hero <video> DOM-visible on desktop (>=768px, no prefers-reduced-motion) with webm-then-mp4 <source> order.
